scope: Qualitative ranking of missing native proofs for this target in the inspected source set; not an exhaustive assertion about all Lean projects.

gaps.title: Actual whole-space H1 local and maximal evolution
gaps.missing_statement: For each physical H1_sigma(R3) datum and nu>0, construct an actual unique local NSE solution with C_t H1 / L2_t H2 regularity and lifespan controlled by its H1 norm; construct its maximal continuation and prove the bounded-H1 continuation criterion.
gaps.attained: Native periodic Galerkin local existence, norm-controlled lifespan, maximal development, overlap uniqueness and restart proofs are collected. A new external source lead has a genuine Fourier H^m fixed-point constructor for m>=3, rather than only a supplied-solution record.
gaps.remaining: The periodic theorem has smooth periodic mean-zero data. The higher-Sobolev external constructor uses viscosity one and a stronger norm. Neither supplies the required native arbitrary-H1 R3 constructor. Heat/Leray estimates, fixed point, initial trace, uniqueness, H1-controlled lifetime and all physical adapters remain.
gaps.rejected_shortcut: A StrongSolutionOnIcc record or ReferenceConstructionFromAbsorption proposition is an interface, not an inhabitant proving existence.

gaps.title: Sharp spatial admission for the registered numerical cutoff
gaps.missing_statement: On the same physical R3 H1 space prove ||v||_6 <= S6 ||grad v||_2 with S6^6=16/(27*pi^4), plus vector/tensor extensions and the H2 Hessian-Laplacian identities used by enstrophy.
gaps.attained: Pinned Mathlib gives a genuine compact-C1 Sobolev estimate with another explicit constant; external gns_L6_of_memH1_R3 gives L6 membership; the accepted cutoff lemma rewrites a supplied sixth-power equality.
gaps.remaining: Extend to the native physical H1 carrier and establish admissibility of the registered S6, not only its arithmetic. ES16 is L2 times gradient-L2 times a Schwartz L-infinity test bound, not the required sharp estimate.
gaps.rejected_shortcut: A proved arbitrary constant changes the associated cutoff. L6 membership, an extremal calculation or the arithmetic identity alone does not justify the frozen tau_A.

gaps.title: Actual physical time evolution, balances and continuation bootstrap
gaps.missing_statement: For the constructed R3 strong solution, prove E and Y absolutely continuous on every closed [0,R] with 0<=R<Tmax, derive E'= -2*nu*Y and Y'+nu*Z <= pi^(-4)*nu^(-3)*Y^3 almost everywhere, and prove the small-product temporal invariant.
gaps.attained: Actual R3 source proofs of H1 convection integrability, weak IBP and antisymmetry; native periodic enstrophy evolution and continuation patterns; finite-interval scalar energy helpers; Mathlib AC FTC; an already named-audited integral Gronwall theorem.
gaps.remaining: Derive time regularity and the physical integral inequality from the actual strong trajectory, with all pressure/spatial cancellations and norms matched. Prove the first-exit bootstrap and same-path continuation. Existing scalar lemmas do not construct the PDE inputs.
gaps.rejected_shortcut: Do not use the global-LH wrapper while proving globality; do not transfer periodic Poincare to R3; do not substitute the historical ES12 threshold ED<4*pi^2*nu^4 for nu^4/S6^6.

gaps.title: Literal Fefferman-A category and terminal control
gaps.missing_statement: Construct velocity/pressure smoothness through t=0 for Schwartz data on all available finite slabs, and identify any literal smooth finite-energy Fefferman competitor with a global canonical H1 development.
gaps.attained: Native pressure-normalization proof, supplied-H3 whole-space pressure/comparison sources, and new external leads for actual physical recovery from all Sobolev orders and smooth finite-energy comparison.
gaps.remaining: Prove all-order propagation and pressure recovery, arbitrary-nu transport where needed, and the finite-slab H1/enstrophy admission necessary to rule out a finite canonical endpoint. Smoothness is lifetime-qualified until globality is proved.
gaps.rejected_shortcut: Agreement on every R<Tmax does not imply a uniform H1 bound as R increases to finite Tmax. Smooth finite L2 energy alone must not be silently strengthened to the strong competitor category.

gaps.title: Native physical H1, Fourier and six-projector identification
gaps.missing_statement: Identify native real compact-test H1 with the spectral membership construction; prove the first-derivative Fourier identity both ways; construct six actual real-preserving vector projections and derivative/solenoidal commutation.
gaps.attained: Complete equalizers and real compact-test separation; actual spectral derivative witnesses; weighted Fourier L2 representatives and reverse membership; bounded measurable scalar L2 multipliers; real L2 Fourier Hermitian symmetry by density.
gaps.remaining: Construct the closed physical gradient graph and its norm. Prove the component/vector/compact-test adapters and the full real-range equivalence; specialize to the fixed six sectors, prove disjointness/reconstruction and physical charge additivity. External pins and private proof templates need explicit native handling.
gaps.rejected_shortcut: Existing native gradient_fourier_ae has a combined gradient/Laplacian witness interface. Do not add an H2 assumption to the H1 projector endpoint or apply a smooth multiplier API to sharp cones.
gaps.dependency_note: This is the first unresolved implementation layer, although the later PDE construction gaps are larger.

gaps.title: Exact stopped-budget and datum-class assembly
gaps.missing_statement: Assemble the factor-six inequality and full ENNReal terminal budgets for the same canonical trajectory; derive finiteness/gauge/sublevel equivalences and the complete datum-class iff.
gaps.attained: Finite Cauchy-Schwarz, squared-norm integrability, monotone nonnegative integration, finite real-integral conversion, ENNReal powers and scalar continuation selectors are available.
gaps.remaining: Supply the physical charges and canonical solution from earlier endpoints, exact measurability, full improper endpoint identity and zero-data cases; prove both directions of the class theorem. This is primarily assembly once the larger constructions exist.
gaps.rejected_shortcut: Never replace the full endpoint budget by separate compact-interval finiteness, or convert an infinite extended lifetime/budget to a misleading real zero.

improved_route.chain: Actual PDE AC enstrophy -> integrated cubic inequality -> existing CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_GRONWALL with a=kappa*Y^2 and e=Y -> uniform enstrophy from full J_A finiteness.
improved_route.boundary: The PDE-to-integral-inequality adapter remains new; no separate general AC Gronwall theorem is required by this preferred route.

external_acceptance_gate.required: Matching authorized cached external compiler, expected-type/literal-contract consumers and named axiom evidence for every new native adapter.

separate_open_problem: Universal budget finiteness / C^A_nu equals all solenoidal Schwartz data remains separate and open.
